title: Cornerstone · Grade 4 — Mathematics Assessment (16 Questions, diagnostic)
_note: Entered 2026-09-20 from the printed page. The Grade 4 child's baseline is NOT the Grade 3 baseline: same header, same sixteen-question shape, different questions — which the page classifier could not tell apart, so his sitting was first read against the wrong paper and twelve of sixteen answers came back not found. Division (question 8) and fractions (9, 10) have no rung on the addition/subtraction ladder; they carry their registry skill and a placeholder rung, which is one of the pedagogy questions already parked for Neha, Achal and Aseem.
